monica-pm: Quick follow-up on INC-2026-04-12 postmortem — action tracker shows 4 open, 2 overdue. Can owners reply with status/DLs? TL;DR list:
```
AI-42 (oliver-sre) - fix connection pool leak - due 2026-03-28 - OVERDUE
AI-45 (ingrid-eng) - add regression test for seqlen bump - due 2026-04-04 - overdue
AI-47 (matt-iss) - DB retry backoff tweak - due 2026-04-10 - in progress
AI-49 (sarah-ops) - runbook + rotation docs - due 2026-04-12 - maybe done?
```
monica-pm: Please paste short status lines only — want to capture ownership + next step in tracker (no long threads).
oliver-sre: Sorry, buried — blocked waiting on infra change (kernel patch) from eng-infra. ETA EOD Tue. Will put blocker + ticket number in tracker now. @monica-pm
reminder-bot: Reminder: 3 open postmortem actions assigned to oliver-sre, ingrid-eng, matt-iss — some due dates have passed. See <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-04-12|INC-2026-04-12 postmortem>.
ingrid-eng: Working on the seqlen test; hit a flaky tokenizer failure in CI. Need 2 more days to stabilize tests, will update tracker with PR when green.
matt-iss: DB patch in progress, reviewer queue is full. I pushed draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/db/pulls/128 — aiming to merge by Fri.
sarah-ops: Runbook is live: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/incident-inc-2026-04-12. Added rotation notes and oncall checklist. Marked AI-49 as DONE in the tracker.
monica-pm: Thanks Sarah. Oliver/Ingird/Matt — if you can't resolve by EOD Fri, I need concrete next-step owners and dates (no open "working on it" lines). We'll escalate after Friday to infra and platform leads.
oliver-sre: Understood. I'm opening infra escalation ticket now and will paste number.
reminder-bot: Escalation scheduled: if any of AI-42/AI-45/AI-47 remain open by 2026-04-18 17:00 UTC, thread will be auto-posted to #eng-platform for triage.
ingrid-eng: Noted. Will aim for green CI + PR before Friday, otherwise tagging qa-eng for help.
matt-iss: If review blocks, I'll drop a checklist in PR and ask @oliver-sre to help with verification to speed merge.
monica-pm: Also flagging a pattern: cache eviction incidents + connection pooling show up in >2 postmortems in last 6 weeks. Can infra/product platform sync to discuss longer-term mitigation?
oliver-sre: Agree — pattern is real. Suggest a short follow-up RFC to capture mitigation options and ownership.
monica-pm: Action owner for RFC? Prefer someone from infra+platform. @oliver-sre do you want to lead with product?
oliver-sre: Happy to start a draft RFC next week, will ping product to co-author.
monica-pm: OK — I'll mark AI-50 (RFC: cache/connpool mitigation) assigned to oliver-sre, due 2026-05-01. Please update tracker entries with PR/ticket links as you make progress.
sarah-ops: Closing note — if anyone wants me to run tabletop for the runbook once the infra changes land, happy to schedule.
monica-pm: Thanks everyone — leaving this thread for closure verification. If I don't see updates by 2026-04-18 17:00 UTC I'll escalate per the reminder-bot rule. :thumbsup:
